headline: Australia S&P/ASX 200 Closes 1.79% Lower Following Tech Sell-Off
summary: Australian equity benchmark S&P/ASX 200 fell 1.79% at the market close as regional technology and financial shares tracked Wall Street losses.
why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's primary stock market index, heavily weighted toward financial institutions and natural resource companies.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: Overnight declines in global equity markets prompted widespread domestic selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Spillover weakness from US and Asian technology equities pressed domestic market sentiment.
